note: Sanctions screening: OpenSanctions consolidated dataset (OFAC SDN, UN, EU, UK, BIS and others; data current as of 2026-11-26) returned 'No matching entities were found' for both 'Global Wave Technologies' and 'Globalwave' — no sanctions exposure identified. Court record: two tax/customs-related matters, both as the party contesting a government authority (Kerala HC 2013 vs Intelligence Officer III; ITAT Cochin 2024 vs ITO Corporate, ITA 760-763/Coch/2023). These are tax-assessment disputes, not criminal matters, and per project rules are not rejection grounds — noted neutrally as 'есть сложности'. The 2013 Kerala HC filing shows the registered address as CSEZ, SDF 17, 4th Floor, Kakkanad, Kochi, and the petitioner represented by director Mr. Ury Stamler — this is a Cochin SEZ-based entity, which is consistent with an export-oriented operation but is NOT evidence of any Russia/CIS supply. Credit rating: null — no rating found from CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings/Acuite in reachable sources; not public. Legal identity, HS code and shipment volumes deliberately not researched per role scope. Caveat: the claimed name 'GLOBALWAVE TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED' (one word) differs from the court-recorded 'Global Wave Technologies Pvt. Ltd.' / 'Global Waves Technologies Pvt. Ltd.' (two words); the match is probable but not confirmed by a CIN, so the court findings should be re-verified against the CIN before being attached to this supplier record.
